evidence.R1-01: round0 CO-S17 row 3 injects OrderNotCancelled right after step 5 'CO-A2 (HG-10482) -> cancelled'; CO-S24 l.1414 injects OrderNotFound for an order 'belongs to the customer' and listed at step 2.
evidence.R1-02: round0 row l.101 'Make no further CO-A2 and no CO-A3; ... make CO-A4' skips the re-read that packet Round 3 Q4 requires after a cancel timeout ('re-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund').
evidence.R1-03: G-04 l.27 allows a repeat 'when the order system guarantees that repeating it creates nothing new', and SG-04 gives that guarantee for cancellation, against packet R3 Q4 'no blind resend'; CO-06 keeps verdicts unchanged (Nit).
evidence.R1-04: Appendix A l.1525 adds 'failure_reason (payment_method_closed, payment_method_expired or declined)'; packet R2 Q3 Refund fields are only id, order number, amount, payment method, status.
evidence.R1-05: CO-02 l.65 has only the ask-which side; every CO-S01 row names its order, so no scenario has an unnamed request with one open order.
evidence.R1-06: CO-S03 Unambiguity note l.292 'Turn 2 replaces the order before any confirmation, so it confirms nothing'; no scenario confirms and then voids.
evidence.R1-07: 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' appears only in the Scope must-not list l.49; no CO rule or §5.2 dimension checks it.
evidence.R1-08: Row l.100 branches on lookup results without a 'not in list' branch; cockburn-checklist.md l.74 requires 'nothing found, a record that matches, a record that does not match, and no answer'.
evidence.R1-09: CO-S17-S23 Forbidden lists (e.g. l.1027-1029) have no 'CO-A2 before the user's confirmation turn' or 'A second CO-A2', and 'exactly once ... after the user's confirmation turn' does not say which occurrences count.
evidence.R1-10: CO-S19 l.1120 'together they create refund RF-5531' leaves open what a CO-A1 between the two CO-A3 shows, though reads are unlimited (Appendix A l.1519).
evidence.R1-11: Dimension l.1504 requires 'that no refund was issued', but failure rows l.100-101 require only 'not known whether the order was cancelled and store staff will follow up'.
evidence.R1-13: CO-S03/S04 Turn 2 trigger 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482 and asks to go ahead' is not a §5.1 event; evaluation-checklist.md l.39 requires a defined event.
evidence.R2-01: round1 row l.108 and dimension l.1659 require 'the refund has not been issued' where packet R3 Q3 confirmed 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet'.
evidence.R2-02: round1 row l.106 tells the customer 'the order is cancelled' after OrderNotCancelled, against G-03 l.24 ('cancelled only when the order system returned it cancelled or a lookup shows it').
evidence.R2-03: CO-08 l.83 'the agent tells the customer the refund id' plus 9-scenario message check; no packet passage or confirmed derivation requires reporting the refund id.
evidence.R2-04: round1 row l.92 'did not answer a lookup ... propose nothing' fires on one timeout, though packet change 4 says 'Reads may be retried on timeout without limit'; CO-S10 fails every CO-A1.
evidence.R2-05: round1 'Cancellation not done reported' l.1663 checks only 'not cancelled' for CO-S25 row 1 (shipped), and 'Whole order only explained' l.1655 omits the refund-terms half CO-03 requires.
evidence.R2-07: CO-01 says propose nothing for a cancelled order, while CO-07 l.80 requires CO-A4 when 'the order is cancelled but its refund is not shown pending or issued'; CO-S06 tests only an issued refund.
evidence.R2-08: Row l.97 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' has only CO-S08 (holding back); no scenario on the acting side.
evidence.R2-09: No rule, row or scenario covers one request naming two open orders; G-01 'at most the one order the current request is about' leaves several behaviors passing.
evidence.R2-10: round1 CO-S11 Unambiguity note l.713 'The status change is tied to the agent's first cancellation ... in row 2 the agent learns the order shipped only from a lookup', and Final state 'status shipped', settle the reading (same defect as dropped R1-12).
evidence.R2-11: CO-S19 Forbidden 'Fewer than one CO-A1 after the second CO-A3' names no call or timing violation, against evaluation-checklist 'Forbidden lines name events'; Nit, no verdict change.
evidence.R3-01: round2 row l.104 'If it shows the order placed or processing, tell the customer the order was not cancelled ... no CO-A4' though SG-04 l.1765 allows an unanswered cancel to take effect late and G-03 requires 'outcome is unknown' when it cannot tell.
evidence.R3-02: round2 rows l.103, l.104, l.109 hand off on one unanswered lookup with no 'look up again' branch (only l.92 has one), and CO-S14/S15/S21 fail every later lookup.
evidence.R3-03: Row l.99 covers a changed 'other proposal term in the confirming turn', but only CO-S03 row 4 (order change) reaches it; CO-S09 asks for another payment method in Turn 1, before any proposal.
evidence.R3-04: CO-S27 l.1630-1631: a question naming all values matches both the optional pair and the confirmation pair; §5.1's tie rule covers only several confirmation-form pairs, so the confirmation label depends on the simulator's pick.
evidence.R3-05: Dimension l.1723 requires 'the refund is not confirmed yet'; for CO-S20 row 1 (lookup shows failed) it does not say whether a truthful 'failed / not issued' passes.
evidence.R3-06: round2 CO-S11 Forbidden l.694-697 has no line requiring a CO-A1 after row 2's unanswered CO-A2, so an agent that guesses 'shipped' with no lookup passes.
evidence.R3-07: CO-S05 note l.405 says the dimension checks 'has shipped and cannot be cancelled', but the definition l.1715 checks 'has shipped ... and was not cancelled'.
evidence.R3-08: CO-S01 note l.177 calls 'Refund id reported' 'the only check on the agent's words' and in the same sentence names rubric dimension 'No arrival date promised'.
